sentences.en: Located in southern Africa just below the Limpopo River, the kingdom of Mapungubwe, flourished between the 11th and 13th century CE
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦王国位于非洲南部，紧邻林波波河以南，在公元11至13世纪间曾盛极一时。

sentences.en: Mapungubwe, which was one of the first states in southern Africa, was formed by Bantu-speaking peoples who were farmers.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦是非洲南部最早的国家之一，由操班图语族语言、以农耕为生的各族群建立。

sentences.en: The area controlled by the rulers of Mapungubwe had at its heart a large sandstone plateau, which was easily defended due to its inaccessibility.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦统治者所控制的地域中央，有一片广阔的砂岩高原。由于难以接近，这片高原很容易防守。

sentences.en: As with other kingdoms in the region of southern Africa, cattle herding and other types of farming brought plenty of food and a surplus that could be traded for needed goods.
sentences.zh: 和非洲南部其他王国一样，马蓬古布韦通过牧牛和其他农业活动获得了充足的食物，还有富余的产品可换取所需的物品。

sentences.en: Archaeology has revealed extensive layers of bones and manure, which indicate that from the 9th century CE there were large cattle herds, the traditional source of political power in southern African communities.
sentences.zh: 考古学家发现了分布广泛的骨骼和粪便堆积层。这表明，从公元9世纪起，当地就有规模庞大的牛群；在非洲南部各社群中，牛群历来是政治权力的来源。

sentences.en: The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.
sentences.zh: 公元10世纪的考古记录显示，该地区家养牛的数量显著增加；当地也已种棉和织布，出土的大量纺轮就是明证。

sentences.en: The total population of Mapungubwe at its peak in the mid-13th century was around 5,000 people.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦在13世纪中叶达到鼎盛，那时的总人口约有五千人。

sentences.en: The chief or king of Mapungubwe was likely the wealthiest individual in the society, and would have owned more cattle and precious materials than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦的首领或国王很可能是社会中最富有的人，他拥有的牛和贵重材料想必比谁都多。

sentences.en: The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length.
sentences.zh: 国王和顾问住在一处由石墙和住房构成的围院里，建在社群领地的最高处，也就是一座约高30米、长100米的天然砂岩山丘上。

sentences.en: Occupation on the hill dates from the 11 th century and the entire complex was surrounded by a wooden palisade*, as indicated by postholes made in the rock.
sentences.zh: 人们从11世纪起便在山丘上居住。整个建筑群四周曾围有一道木栅栏，这一点可由岩石上凿出的柱洞看出。

sentences.en: The rest of the community lived in mud and thatch housing spread out below the hill, although there is one stone structure here.
sentences.zh: 社群里的其他人住在山下散布的泥墙茅草屋中，不过这里也有一座石造建筑。

sentences.en: This settlement, known as Babandyanalo, covers around 5 hectares (12.3 acres) and predates the hilltop structures.
sentences.zh: 这处聚落名为巴班迪亚纳洛，占地约5公顷（12.3英亩），建成时间比山顶那些建筑更早。

sentences.en: The kings of Mapungubwe were buried at the top of the hill site in a demarcated area away from the dwellings, while other members of the community were buried at the surrounding valley level.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦的国王埋葬在山顶一片划定的区域，那里远离居所；社群里的其他成员则葬在周围较低的谷地。

sentences.en: A wooden staircase connected the two levels, the sockets for the steps being clearly visible in the sandstone cliff face.
sentences.zh: 一座木梯连接着这两个高低不同的区域；如今在砂岩崖壁上仍能清楚看见当初用来嵌入踏步的凹孔。

sentences.en: There were some grander residences dotted around the outskirts of Babandyanalo, and these probably belonged to male relatives of the king.
sentences.zh: 巴班迪亚纳洛的外围散落着一些较为气派的住宅，它们很可能属于国王的男性亲属。

sentences.en: There are many other smaller but still impressive sites across the Mapungubwe plateau, which are located anywhere from 15 to 100 kilometres from the major hill site.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦高原各处还有许多规模更小但仍然引人注目的遗址，它们离主要的山丘遗址有的15公里，有的远达100公里。

sentences.en: Containing stone residences and walls, they likely belonged to local chiefs who acted as servants to the king.
sentences.zh: 这些遗址上有石砌住所和围墙，很可能原本属于臣服于国王的地方首领。

sentences.en: The Mapungubwe plateau has a very high number of carnivore animal remains and ivory splinters, suggesting that the skins of these large animals and ivory elephant tusks were accumulated, probably for trade with coastal areas reached by the Limpopo River.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦高原发现了数量极多的食肉动物遗骸和象牙碎片，这表明人们曾积存这些大型动物的皮和大象的长牙，很可能是为了与沿林波波河可抵达的沿海地区贸易。

sentences.en: The presence of glass beads, almost certainly from India, indicate there was trade of some sort with other states on the coast who, in turn, traded with merchants travelling from India by sea.
sentences.zh: 此地发现了几乎可以肯定来自印度的玻璃珠，表明马蓬古布韦与沿海其他国家有过某种贸易往来；这些国家又与从印度走海路而来的商人做生意。

sentences.en: Mapungubwe also benefitted from locally-sourced copper and the gold trade as it passed from the kingdom of Great Zimbabwe (12-15th century), situated to the north of Mapungubwe, to the coastal city of Kosala.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦还受益于当地产的铜和途经这里的黄金贸易。黄金从马蓬古布韦以北的大津巴布韦王国（12至15世纪）运往沿海城市科萨拉。

sentences.en: It is likely that trade links led to a strengthening of political authority in order to control and even monopolise these lucrative interregional connections.
sentences.zh: 这些贸易联系很可能促使统治者加强了政治权威，以便控制、甚至垄断这些利润丰厚的跨地区往来。

sentences.en: Archaeological discoveries reveal that pottery was produced on a scale large enough to suggest the presence of professional potters, and is another indicator of the prosperity of Mapungubwe society.
sentences.zh: 考古发现显示，当时的陶器生产规模很大，足以让人推断已有专业陶工。这也是马蓬古布韦社会繁荣的另一项证据。

sentences.en: Archaeological finds include spherical vessels with short necks, beakers, and bowls, many of which have decorative stamps.
sentences.zh: 出土物包括短颈球形容器、大口杯和碗，其中很多都印有装饰纹样。

sentences.en: There are also ceramic discs, and whistles.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有陶制圆片和哨子。

sentences.en: In addition, cattle, sheep, and goat figurines, and small figures of highly stylised humans with elongated bodies and short limbs have been found.
sentences.zh: 此外还出土了牛、绵羊、山羊的小塑像，以及一些十分风格化的人形小像，躯干细长，四肢短小。

sentences.en: The figures may have been used in ceremonies as offerings to ancestors, but their precise function is not known.
sentences.zh: 这些小像或许曾在仪式中被当作给祖先的供品，但它们的确切用途仍不得而知。

sentences.en: Other discoveries include small jewellery items made from locally sourced copper.
sentences.zh: 其他发现还包括用当地产的铜制作的小件首饰。

sentences.en: Beautifully decorated artefacts made of gold have also been found at Mapungubwe.
sentences.zh: 马蓬古布韦还出土了装饰精美的金制器物。

sentences.en: A type of decoration, found nowhere else except Great Zimbabwe, involved the crafting of gold into small rectangular sheets and carving geometrical patterns into it.
sentences.zh: 有一种装饰工艺，除此地以外只在大津巴布韦发现过：把黄金制成小块长方形薄片，再在上面刻出几何图案。

sentences.en: These sheets were then used to cover wooden objects (which have not survived) using small tacks, also made of gold.
sentences.zh: 接下来，人们用小钉把这些金片固定在木器表面。这些木器如今已不存，那些小钉也是金制的。

sentences.en: One such object that has been discovered may have been a sceptre, while additional evidence of local gold-working is a rhinoceros figurine made from small hammered sheets, and thousands of small gold beads.
sentences.zh: 出土的一件这类器物可能是权杖；当地加工黄金的其他证据，还有一尊用锤打成的小金片制成的犀牛像，以及数以千计的小金珠。

sentences.en: These objects were all found at the royal burial site and date to c. 1150.
sentences.zh: 这些器物全都出土于王室墓地，年代约为公元1150年。

sentences.en: They are the first known indicators that gold had an intrinsic value of its own (as opposed to that of a currency) in southern Africa.
sentences.zh: 这些器物是目前所知最早的证据，表明在非洲南部，黄金除作为货币的价值外，自身还具有内在价值。

sentences.en: The kingdom of Mapungubwe was already in decline by the late 13th century, probably because overpopulation placed too much stress on local resources, a situation that may have been brought to a crisis point by a series of droughts.
sentences.zh: 到13世纪末，马蓬古布韦王国已在走下坡路，很可能是人口过多给当地资源带来了过重的负担；接连发生的干旱或许又把局面推到了危急关头。

sentences.en: Trade routes may also have shifted northwards.
sentences.zh: 贸易路线也可能向北转移了。

sentences.en: Certainly, the areas that now prospered were to the north, such as Great Zimbabwe.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，这时兴盛起来的地区都位于北方，大津巴布韦便是其中之一。
